segments: A detailed guide to all core Nix package-manager commands and their arguments.

The new CLI examples have been corrected against the Nix 2.34 reference manual; older versions may use different profile-selection syntax and Flake-update arguments. The system rebuild program, Home Manager, and Nix are separate tools, and their options are not interchangeable. The code below is a command reference, not a script to run in full at once.
Nix commands fall into two main categories:
New commands (nix build, nix develop, etc.) - require the nix-command experimental feature
New commands in the Flakes era

nix shell primarily provides tools on PATH; it is not the full build environment provided by nix develop. --print-out-paths prints output paths but still performs a build; --no-link controls whether a link is created. Arguments after nix fmt, such as --check, belong to the actual formatter, so check whether the project's formatter supports them. Older --update-input examples use a legacy compatibility interface; modern Nix supports nix flake update nixpkgs. Quote SSH store URIs containing characters such as ?. Manual nix-store --delete operations, profile deletion, system installation, and activation all change state. Confirm the target, backups, and generations to retain before running them. nixos-rebuild test actually starts and stops services; VM builds, dry-build, and flake check cannot replace validation of actual activation behavior.
